test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Rajdhani Express and Garib Rath Express run in the same direction with speeds of 87 km/hr and 51 km/hr, respectively, and their lengths are the same. What is the length of the Rajdhani Express if it completely crosses the Garib Rath Express in 175 seconds?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed = 87 − 51 = 36 km/hr = 10 m/s

Same length trains ⇒ total distance = 2L

Time = 175 sec ⇒ 2L = 10 × 175 = 1750

L = 1750 ÷ 2 = 875

**∴ Answer = 875 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Rajdhani = 87 km/hr, Speed of Garib Rath = 51 km/hr, Time = 175 sec, lengths are equal

**Formula used:**

Distance = Relative Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 87 − 51 = 36 km/hr

⇒ Convert to m/s ⇒ 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

⇒ Total distance covered = 10 × 175 = 1750 m

⇒ Since both trains have equal length ⇒ total distance = 2L

⇒ 2L = 1750

⇒ L = 875 m

**∴ The correct answer is 875 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Same direction ⇒ subtract speeds, opposite direction ⇒ add speeds.

Train Crossing Rule

Distance covered = sum of lengths when trains cross each other.

Speed Conversion

Multiply km/hr by 5/18 to convert into m/s.
